description: Structured types in casts including RENAME FIELDS / ADD FIELDS, all live-measured: plain values cast to structured types when the key set matches EXACTLY (field types applied, unconvertible values and NOT NULL violations failing Typed object schema mismatch, field names case-sensitive and never folded, duplicates rejected, NULL staying NULL); RENAME FIELDS maps POSITIONALLY (converting to target types, equal field counts required) while ADD FIELDS matches BY NAME (new fields null, target order, every source field kept, no-op legal); both modifiers demand a structured source AND target of the same family at COMPILE time, recurse into nested structures and ARRAY elements, are ignored at MAP level, and are refused by TRY_CAST and impossible in the :: shorthand; structured-to-structured without a modifier keeps the field layout (leaf types may change); structured columns keep their declared shape; OBJECT() is its own zero-field type and empty type parentheses are a character-type leniency only. Converted 1:1 from expressions/StructuredTypeSyntaxTest (now retired).
